lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible on the mid-lateral flank. Posterior to the pectoral fin, these form approximately four distinct horizontal rows of three to five visible nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, particularly visible in the central flank region, creating a matrix-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible extending from the posterior head across the upper flank, exhibiting a high-contrast transition from a light dorsal surface to a shadowed ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular indentation on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
